phase_plan.activation_condition: The returned passages visibly cover only part of the relations requested by the user question.
phase_plan.instruction: Append a concise, answer-free reminder to identify the still unsupported relation before choosing the next action.
phase_plan.expected_effect: The next Student generation explicitly identifies an evidence gap.

phase_plan.activation_condition: The proposed final answer is still unsupported by a complete visible relation chain.
phase_plan.instruction: Defer finalization once and ask the Student to resolve the named evidence gap using its normal tools.
phase_plan.expected_effect: The Student performs a follow-up retrieval before finalizing.

evaluation.success_condition: At least one tool call occurs after activation and before finalization.
evaluation.falsifier: The Student finalizes without another tool call after activation.

hypothesis.applicability: Multi-hop, comparison, or bridge questions where the initial search covers only part of the user-visible entities or factual relations and at least one Student step remains. It does not assume that every missing relation exists in the retrieval corpus.

input.trial_objective: Test whether a question-derived evidence-coverage checklist, appended immediately after the first search result, causes the Student to retrieve evidence for an uncovered named entity before answering.
prohibited_content: the golden answer or any equivalent answer
facts not present in the original question or returned passages
hidden gold evidence or a precomputed entity path
